title: Spotify review pipeline output schema (schema-v1)
description: Shapes of grading/records.jsonl(.gz) rows (one per source review_id), out/full/enriched.jsonl.gz, out/full/quarantine.jsonl.gz and grading/calls.jsonl(.gz). Validated in code (pipeline/enrich.py parse_jev + commit_batch, tools/check_submission.py).

intent.description: precedence: cancellation > complaint > request > praise > unclear

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of compact UTF-8 JSON of the six source fields (course row_sha helper)

sentiment.description: Jev Score position s in 0..4 mapped to s/2 - 1

entities.description: feature terms matched by a fixed lexicon in code

evidence_quote.description: exact substring of review_text: whole text if <= 200 chars, else a gpt-6-luna span checked in code

needs_review.description: true if any Jev topic/intent/severity confidence < 0.5, quote fallback, or non-Latin script

label_config.description: model+prompt+schema versions; exact-text reuse requires identical label_config

cache_source_id.description: present when this record reuses the validated result of a completed original with identical text

result_cache_run.description: present only for result-cache hits from another run's state (warm pilot)

review_reasons.description: why needs_review is set, e.g. low_confidence:topic

attempts.description: quarantine.jsonl only: model attempts made for this record

review_ids.description: IDs actually sent; enrichment requests carry 1-50

cost_usd.description: usage x dated rates in config/rates.csv
